app.name: Langle
popup.sync.space: Sync space: {used} KB of {quota} KB used
wordlist.title: Word list
settings.title: Settings
settings.languages.lead: Langle highlights pages written in your learning language and translates into your own language.
settings.languages.learningDesc: Pages and subtitles in this language get highlights.
settings.languages.nativeDesc: Meanings and translations are shown in this language.
settings.languages.uiDesc: Language of Langle's own buttons and menus. More languages are planned.
settings.languages.dataDesc: Words and dictionaries Langle keeps on this device.
settings.languages.dataUnused: Not used by your languages now · {size} MB
settings.level.lead: Words you have never saved count as New unless they are among the most common words. Raise the number as your vocabulary grows.
settings.level.label: Treat the {count} most common {language} words as known
settings.level.note: Words you have saved always keep the status you gave them.
settings.highlighting.lead: Choose which kinds of words are highlighted on pages and in subtitles.
settings.highlighting.newDesc: Words you have not saved that are above your level.
settings.highlighting.learningDesc: Words and phrases you are studying. On by default.
settings.highlighting.knownDesc: Words you have marked as known.
settings.appearance.themeDesc: System follows your browser's light or dark mode.
settings.highlighting.unsavedAtEndDesc: What happens to them when a video ends or you reach the end of an article. Keep as New leaves them for next time; Mark as Known saves them all as Known.
settings.dictionaries.lead: Links shown in the dictionary window. Each one opens in a new tab with the word filled in.
settings.ai.title: On-device AI
settings.ai.desc: {browser}'s built-in AI explains a word in the sentence you met it in, in the dictionary window. It runs on this device.
settings.ai.unknown.title: Explain words the dictionary doesn't have
settings.ai.unknown.desc: As soon as the dictionary window opens. Words with an entry are explained when you press Explain in context.
settings.video.lead: Where Langle shows the current subtitle line on YouTube and Netflix. You can also switch it under the video.
settings.video.inVideoDesc: Shown over the bottom of the video, like normal subtitles.
settings.video.belowVideoDesc: Shown in a larger box under the player, so nothing covers the picture.
settings.video.subtitleTranslationDesc: The line in your language below the current subtitle.
settings.video.transcriptTranslationDesc: The line in your language on each transcript card. Set separately from the subtitle.
settings.sites.lead: Where Langle runs. You can also switch it off for one site from the toolbar popup.
settings.sites.youtubeDesc: Subtitle bar, transcript and dictionary window on video pages.
settings.sites.youtubeCommentsDesc: Highlights and dictionary in the comments under a video.
settings.sites.articlesDesc: Highlights and dictionary on pages written in your learning language.
settings.sites.invalid: Enter a site such as example.com
settings.history.lead: Sentences from pages and videos you open with Langle on, kept on this device so the dictionary can show where you met a word before you saved it.
settings.history.switchDesc: Never synced. Pages on your Never run on list are not kept.
settings.history.pages: {count} pages and videos · the oldest are removed first when space runs out
settings.history.onePage: 1 page or video · the oldest are removed first when space runs out
settings.history.clearDesc: Saved words and their sources stay.
settings.sync.lead: Langle has no server. Your words are kept in this browser and, if you like, synced through {syncName}.
settings.sync.switchDesc: Reaches your other devices when you are signed in to {browser} with sync on. Only each word and its status are synced; sources and sentences stay on this device.
settings.backup.title: Backup file
settings.backup.desc: Everything, including sources and sentences, in one JSON file.
settings.cloud.title: Your own cloud storage
settings.cloud.desc: Sync everything through Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, a folder on this computer or WebDAV, for when {syncName} space runs out.
settings.cloud.descNoFolder: Sync everything through Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or WebDAV, for when {syncName} space runs out.
settings.about.line: Langle {version} · Data: Wiktionary (CC BY-SA), EJDict-hand, wordnets, Universal Dependencies
notices.title: Data sources and licenses
notices.lead: Langle downloads the language data it uses. Each package below is licensed as a whole as shown, and lists the sources it was made from with their licenses.
dict.title: Dictionary
dict.explain.download: {browser}'s on-device AI is downloaded once before its first use.
dict.explain.noFit: None of the dictionary's meanings fit here.
dict.phrase.label: Phrase
dict.notSavedNote: Not saved yet. Save it as Learning or Known and Langle will remember where you see it next.
saveAll.note: Words you have already saved keep their status. Words inside the common-word level are not counted.
video.subtitle: Subtitle
page.words.title: Words on this page
video.toggle.on: Langle is on — click to turn off
video.toggle.off: Langle is off — click to turn on
support.title: Support Langle
support.lead: Langle is free. Your support keeps me going and lets Langle keep growing.
support.nudge.title: Nice work! You've hit {count} words in Learning.
support.nudge.line: Enjoying Langle? A quick rating below helps other learners find it.
sponsor.commission: Langle may earn a commission if you sign up.
sponsor.open: Your product here, in front of people learning {language}.
